item.title: ❤️ Breathtaking: For the first time in the Russian Navy history, the Northern Fleet vessels pass through the Shokalsky Strait
item.description: ❤️ Breathtaking: For the first time in the Russian Navy history, the Northern Fleet vessels pass through the Shokalsky Strait 📍 The route passed between the islands of the Severnaya Zemlya archipelago. 🚁 Ice surveillance: a Ka-29 helicopter took off from the icebreaking patrol ship Ivan Papanin to reconnoitre the route from the air. 🌊 Manoeuvring among icebergs: the crew faced a difficult ice situation of the strait. The Northern Fleet's sailors quickly changed their course and speed to ensure complete navigation safety. ▫️ Combat readiness: training alert was announced to pass through the strait by ships, and crews successfully assessed this new area for futher actions of the Russian Navy. ⚓️ We are proud of our sailors! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces
continue to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone
in Kharkov region.
🚩
As a result of active offensive actions, the settlement of Kreydyanka (Kharkov region) has been liberated.
💥
Combat operations
are conducted
inside the encirclement
to liberate Nesternoye, Lukashovo, and Grachevka, Rublenoye, and Reznikovo (Kharkov region).
A complex fire damage was inflicted on
the concentration areas of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade close to Khatneye (Kharkov region).
▪️
During the day, the enemy lost more than 60 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and two motor vehicles.
📍
While expanding the external control zone, the combat actions are underway
for the liberation of Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition,
in Kharkov region
,
strikes were delivered at
manpower concentration areas and strongholds of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine close to Ivashki and Konstantinovka.
🔥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade near Khoten, Kiyanitsa, Velikaya Rybitsa, and Malaya Rybitsa.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 315 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 25 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, one territorial defence brigade, and one national guard brigade near Brusovka, Mayaki, Sidorovo, Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic), Maliyevka, and Osinovo (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, six armoured fighting vehicles, 15 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one marine brigade close to Belenkoye, Druzhkovka, Nikolayevka, Kramatorsk, and Semenovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 205 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 19 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.

item.title: 🇷🇺 Military Union strengthening: Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Osmakov holds a series of talks with the Mongolian Defence Ministry's leadership.
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇳 Military Union strengthening: Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Osmakov holds a series of talks with the Mongolian Defence Ministry's leadership. 📑 Long-term work The meeting between Vasily Osmakov and his Mongolian counterpart, Major General Baasandamba Dashtseden, resulted in the signing of the fundamental document – the 2027–2031 Russian-Mongolian Strategic Partnership Plan in the Military Field. 🤝 All levels' sustainable interaction A vector to strengthen ties was approved at the meeting between Vasily Osmakov and Mongolia's Defence Minister Dambyn Batlut. To date, a solid working relationship has been worked out between the countries: general staffs, frontier military districts, various branches of the armed forces, and various military higher schools are effectively cooperating. 🧭 Revised our priorities and determined common vector In addition, Vasily Osmakov held talks with Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mongolia Lieutenant General Sunrev Ganbyamba. The Russian side highly commended the accuracy of the April agreements implementation. Lieutenant General Sunrev Ganbyamba assured that Mongolian General Staff personally oversees the implementation of the new five-year plan. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:

The Russian side highly commended the accuracy of the April agreements implementation. 🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike with ground-based high-precision weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike with ground-based high-precision weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres, port, transport infrastructure facilities, and vessels operating in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: 📍 in Kiev: ▫️ a locomotive shed equipped with a depot storing FP-5 Flamingo ground-based missiles and their components; ▫️ the Bimobile data processing centre, one of the main internet exchange points, ensuring the stability of information exchange, including intelligence data, in the interests of the AFU; ▫️ the Parkovy data centre, which processed public and commercial services' data, inter alia in the interests of the AFU; 📍 in Kiev region, the Belogorodka logistics depot, where fixed-wing UAVs were manufactured and stored; 📍 in Odessa region: ▫️ the Usatovo power substation, providing electricity to the Ukrainian ports' infrastructure facilities; ▫️ a fixed-wing UAV manufacturing workshop in the settlement of Velikodolinskoye; ▫️ in the port of Izmail, port infrastructure facilities used to unload military cargo; ▫️ in the port of Odessa, a dry cargo ship, delivering cargo intended to support the AFU. 💥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to the port of Odessa was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
